panel.title: Select panel
panel.description: Choose your iPIXEL panel from the devices seen by the Home Assistant Bluetooth stack ({device_count} found, ★ = recognised iPIXEL panel), or enter the address manually.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of the panel.

group.title: Combined display
group.description: Select the panels that together form one large display. In the next steps you place each panel on a grid (row/column). Images and GIFs are first stored in the given slot on every panel and then shown with one simultaneous command, so the picture appears on all panels at once. While you place the panels, each panel shows the last four characters of its address. Panels marked "new" are not configured yet and will be added automatically.

group_position.title: Position of {panel} ({index}/{total})
group_position.description: Row 0 is the top row, column 0 the left-most panel. Panels in the same row are placed side by side ordered by column.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Make sure the panel is powered on, in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy, and not connected to the phone app.
error.panel_cannot_connect: Panel {panel} could not be reached; make sure it is powered on and not connected to the phone app.

abort.not_enough_panels: At least two panels (configured or visible over Bluetooth) are needed for a combined display.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the panel.

panel.title: Panel options
panel.description: Override the detected size when it is wrong (0 = automatic). The BLE packet size is chosen automatically (244 bytes on a local adapter, 100 through a Bluetooth proxy) and lowered when uploads fail; set it to force a value.

group.title: Combined display
group.description: Change the panels of this combined display. In the next steps you place each panel on the grid. Images and GIFs are first stored in the given slot on every panel and then shown with one simultaneous command, so the picture appears on all panels at once. While you place the panels, each panel shows the last four characters of its address.
